name: Review and QA Contract
contextRequirements: Load changed files and relevant release docs.
Load validation scripts and check outputs.
Load relevant standards and decision records.
taskBoundary: Review repository changes for correctness, consistency, missing tests, and release-scope drift.
outputFormat: Findings first, then open questions, then verification summary.
refusalRules: Refuse to approve changes without checking relevant validation scripts.
Refuse to hide scope drift in a summary.
Refuse to rely on chat-only rationale for repository changes.
